channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "The Blood Craving Giant (SCP-6001)" - I have attempted to make an SCP and I think it turned out alright. I'd like some criticism on what could be improved or if more information is needed.

item.title: Forum Crit Team - Staff Post
item.content:encoded:
Author, per the required reading forum guidelines: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282684/required-reading:how-to-use-this-forum-ideas please fill out the concept template to seek feedback on your idea. Additionally: if you wish to share the full text of a draft, please use the SCP Sandbox so you can share a link to it instead of pasting the full draft into a forum thread.

Remember to please edit your previous post using the "edit" function under the "options" tab to the lower right of your first comment rather than creating a new thread.

Once you have revised your post accordingly, please reach out to reviewers to request that they look at your thread. You can find a list of ways to contact reviewers in this thread: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

item.title: The Blood Craving Giant (SCP-6001)
item.content:encoded: ~No full drafts in the forum please. You can find your draft in the post history.
